newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Nalco down 6.0 pct after results.
newsitem.headline: India's Nalco down 6.0 pct after results.

text.p: Shares of India's largest aluminium maker National Aluminium Company Ltd (NALCO) dropped 3.0 rupees, or nearly six percent, to 49 on the Bombay bourse on Tuesday after the firm announced a fall in its net profit.
NALCO said its net profit during 1996/97 (April-March) dropped to 4.79 billion rupees, from 5.35 billion a year earlier.
Analysts said the results fell slightly below the consensus forecast of 4.8 billion to 5.0 billion rupees.
"But all aluminium companies are bound to report lower profits in 1996/97 because of low international prices," said an analyst at a UK-based brokerage.
Global aluminium prices hit a two-and-a-half year low of just below $1,300 a tonne on the London Metals Exchange last October, before reversing a prolonged downtrend.
